scope: Verify the public legal/news record behind the Gable Steveson case reference in the supplied UFC 331 Short. Public unauthenticated sources only.

sources.title: No charges against UM wrestlers, investigation continues
supports: Hennepin named criminal-sexual-conduct allegations against Gable Steveson and Dylan Martinez.
No charges could be brought at that time.
The investigation remained active and prosecutors would review additional evidence.
limits: This was an interim June release, not the final public charging decision.
It does not establish whether the allegation occurred.

sources.title: No charges filed against University of Minnesota wrestlers following criminal sexual assault investigation
supports: The Minneapolis Police Department investigation was reviewed by veteran prosecutors and senior leadership.
The Hennepin County Attorney's Office did not file charges.
The prosecutor cited conflicting versions and inadequate evidence to fairly charge and prosecute.
The office said Minnesota intoxication/consent law constrained how it could charge the case.
limits: The statement is a prosecutorial decision, not a trial verdict.
It does not make a factual finding that the allegation was true or false.

findings.allegation: A criminal-sexual-conduct allegation/investigation was publicly identified by Hennepin County in June 2019.
findings.charge_status: No criminal charges were filed against the wrestlers in the investigation, per the December 20, 2019 Hennepin release.
findings.prosecutorial_decision: After review, prosecutors declined to file charges, citing conflicting accounts and inadequate evidence to fairly charge and prosecute.
findings.legal_outcome: No criminal trial, conviction, acquittal, dismissal, or judicial finding is established by this bundle; no charges were filed.
findings.news_peg: The UFC 331 press-conference page verifies the event context, but a fighter's accusation remains an attributed public statement rather than an adjudicated fact.
